title: Detection of Human IgG Anti-Pertussis Toxin
author: Adria D. Lee
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kvwcw7e
materials: Bring TMB substrate and Stop solutions to room temperature (18-26°C).

steps.title: Prepare Coating Solution
steps.instruction: Allow Coating Buffer and PT antigen to reach room temperature (18-26°C), then add PT antigen to Coating buffer and gently vortex to mix.

steps.title: Coat Microtiter Strips
steps.instruction: Dispense 100 μL of Coating solution into each well of the microtiter strip assembly, cover with a plate sealer, and incubate overnight (14 to 24 hours) at 2-8°C.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Samples
steps.instruction: Allow Standards, Kit controls, samples, Assay buffer, Standard & Kit control diluent, Wash solution concentrate, and PT coated microtiter strips to reach room temperature (18-26°C).

substeps.instruction: Dilute the Wash solution concentrate with de-ionized water in the microtiter plate/strip washer reservoir and mix gently.
Prepare serum samples by mixing 20 μL of serum to 1980 μL of Assay buffer; gently vortex each sample prior to use.
Reconstitute IgG anti-PT standards by adding 1 mL of Standard & Kit control diluent into each vial and gently vortexing.
Reconstitute IgG anti-PT controls by adding 1 mL of Standard & Kit control diluent to each vial and gently vortexing.

steps.title: Initial Wash and Sample Loading
steps.instruction: Wash the coated microtiter strips three times with 300 μL of Wash solution per well. Pipette 100 μL of Standards, Kit controls, and serum samples into wells in triplicate.

substeps.instruction: Ensure all standards, controls, and test samples are dispensed within 15 minutes to minimize assay drift.

steps.title: Primary Incubation
steps.instruction: Cover the microtiter plate with a plate sealer and incubate for 2 hours ± 5 minutes at room temperature (18-26°C).

steps.title: Conjugate Preparation and Addition
steps.instruction: Wash microtiter strips three times with 300 μL of Wash solution per well. Prepare the conjugate and add to the wells.

substeps.instruction: Prepare conjugate by diluting room temperature Peroxidase labeled mouse monoclonal anti-human IgG conjugate (1:5000 dilution in 50% glycerol) with Assay buffer and gently vortexing.
Pipette 100 μL of Conjugate solution into all coated wells.

steps.title: Secondary Incubation
steps.instruction: Seal the plate and incubate for 2 hours ± 5 minutes at room temperature (18-26°C).

steps.title: Substrate Addition and Development
steps.instruction: Wash microtiter strips three times with 300 μL of Wash solution per well, then add TMB substrate.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 100 μL of TMB substrate solution into all coated wells.
Incubate 9-11 minutes at room temperature (18-26°C), avoiding direct exposure to light.

steps.title: Stop Reaction and Measurement
steps.instruction: Pipette 100 μL of Stop Solution into all coated wells and measure the absorbance at 450 nm within 30 minutes of adding Stop solution.
